title: Topic 16
japanese_text:
A：この間出張中に大雪にあってさ。<u>急きょ</u>近くに泊まることにしたんだけど、宿が見つからなくてね。
B：<u>とんだ</u>1日だね。
A：でも予約<u>制</u>の<u>民宿</u>に電話したら泊めてもらえてね。<u>てっきり</u>断られるかと思ったけど。帰りも周りを<u>探検したり</u>、おいしいものを食べたりもして、結果的には大<u>満喫</u>。
english_translation: A: I was on a business trip the other day and it snowed so hard that suddenly I had to stay overnight, but I couldn't find a place to stay. B: What a terrible day! A: But I called a guest house that usually requires bookings system, and they let me stay there. I thought they would certainly refuse me. On the way back, I explored the local area, ate some delicious food, and ended up fully enjoying the experience.
